noun_definition: Workspace refers to a collaborative environment created by a user where members can be invited and managed.
Invite member refers to the action of selecting and adding a user to a workspace through the member invitation interface.
Tooltip refers to the small popup text that appears when hovering over a user's name in the member list, intended to display the user's display name.
Display name refers to the name associated with a user account that is shown in tooltips when hovering over the user's entry in the member list.
Member list refers to the list of users displayed during the workspace invitation process, where each entry represents a potential or existing workspace member.
